verdict.rationale: Rippling documents several bulk-action features (approve dependents/route EOI in bulk, bulk coverage updates) and a broader platform/API/CLI for building custom workflows and reports across HR/IT/finance data, which could support bulk operations. However there is no direct evidence of a general-purpose bulk-operation capability exposed for AI-native/agentic use (e.g., bulk API calls, batch endpoints documented for automation) beyond a few specific HR features and a CSV-import incident. missing for 10: explicit API/CLI batch-operation documentation, agent-facing bulk action examples, independent verification of large-scale automated bulk workflows.
